notes: All 78 cards compared against Plates 9, 19-20, 38-40, 46, 48, 54, 59-64, 66, 76, 82, 92, 97, 106-107, 127-146, Plates 170/183/184 (back) and Muscle Tables 2.4-2.9 / 3.x. Motor 'Supplies' lists for CN III/IV/VI/V3, VII, IX, X (pharyngeal plexus), XI, XII, ansa cervicalis, SLN/RLN, nerve to mylohyoid, suboccipital nerve and dorsal scapular nerve agree with Netter's innervation column. Foramina for CN I-XII, chorda tympani (petrotympanic fissure), auricular branch of X (mastoid canaliculus) and tympanic nerve (inferior tympanic canaliculus) agree with Plates 19-20. Not corrected but worth knowing: (1) CN XI card says spinal root C1-C5; Plate 138 labels only C1-C4 spinal nerves beside the root and gives no explicit upper-limit statement, so left as is. (2) Cervical sympathetic cards say preganglionic outflow T1-T4; Netter schemas show T1-T2 (Plates 143-145), T1-T3 (Plate 62) and cite lateral horn 'T1-5' - no single explicit figure, so left. (3) Netter uses 'posterior ramus' rather than 'dorsal ramus' and 'anterior/posterior division' of V3 rather than 'trunk'; these are synonyms and were not flagged except where branch content changed. (4) Netter has no head/neck plate for the long thoracic, suprascapular or dorsal scapular nerve courses (upper-limb section not supplied); only the levator scapulae/rhomboid innervation entries in Table 3.3 were checked and agree. (5) Pearls were checked against Clinical Tables 2.1-2.3 (CN I avulsion, CN XI node biopsy, RLN, Bell palsy, uvula/tongue deviation, cavernous sinus) with no conflicts found. (6) Netter 7th ed. names used by the cards (tympanic nerve of Jacobson, carotid sinus nerve of Hering, nerve to mylohyoid muscle, auriculotemporal nerve, 3rd occipital nerve) match; the eponym 'Arnold' for the auricular branch of X is not used by Netter but is not contradicted.
